title: TeoriaTeotl: computational demonstrations for Teotl Field Theory
description:
Runnable checks accompanying the Teotl Field Theory programme: a phase field on ordinary space and time, from which the code derives or tests electromagnetism, emergent gravity, the galactic acceleration scale, quantum-correlation results (CHSH closure, Born rule, number–phase uncertainty), and the particle sector.

Each script is standalone, prints its own result, and states what it establishes. The repository is deliberately a dated record: scripts and gate notes are not rewritten when a later audit changes a reading. Corrections are carried in banners at the top of the affected file, and DERIVED_SUMMARY.md holds the current status of every claim. Where a gate record and the summary disagree, the summary is current.

The SPARC galaxy analysis is reproducible from public data with the code included here.
